title: Surreal Horse Portrait
description: A large stylized woman's face occupies the right side of the frame, her skin covered in a vibrant geometric mosaic of pink, green, yellow, and purple triangles. Her long flowing black hair merges with a lush green landscape on the left, where a man in a dark blue coat stands on a hill watching several orange horses gallop through fields of oversized pink flowers.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant woman's face on the right with skin made of colorful geometric triangular mosaic in pink, green, yellow and purple. Her long black hair transforms into a rolling green hillside landscape. A man in a dark blue coat stands on a hill watching several fiery orange horses galloping through the scene. Large pink flowers with yellow centers fill the foreground, dramatic cloudy sky above, painterly style with rich textures and vibrant contrasting colors.
